dict.string: We need access to your location while using the app to show nearby business listings and provide location-based recommendations, such as deals or promotions in your area.

We need access to your location at all times to display relevant business listings, offer location-based deals, and keep you updated with real-time information, even when the app is in the background.
We need access to your location at all times to send you location-based notifications, such as nearby offers, business updates, or event alerts, even when the app is not open.
We need access to your location to display the distance between you and nearby businesses. For example, when viewing a business listing, you can see how far it is from your current location.
This app requires access to your photo library so you can select and upload images for your profile or business listings.
This app needs access to the camera to allow users to take photos for their profile or upload images to business listings.
This app needs access to the microphone to record audio messages or voice notes that can be attached to business listings or support requests.
